claims.claim: Knesset elections fall on the third Tuesday of Cheshvan of the year the outgoing Knesset term ends (four years from election). The 25th Knesset was elected on 1.11.2022, and 5787 follows a non-leap year, so the statutory date is the third Tuesday of Cheshvan 5787, 27 October 2026 (late October 2026).

claims.notes: Date derived: 1 Cheshvan 5787 = Monday 12.10.2026, so its Tuesdays are 13, 20 and 27 October. 5786 is not a leap year, so the third-Tuesday rule applies. Unless the Knesset dissolves early and sets another date.
